newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gengold may cut Kinross operations.
newsitem.headline: Gengold may cut Kinross operations.

text.p: Gencor Ltd's gold division Gengold said on Monday it might downscale operations at its Kinross Mines Ltd if the mine did not improve its performance.
Gengold managing director Tom Dale said at the result presentation on Monday that Kinross posted a marginal increase in gold production in the three months to end-September.
"We've got a marginal improvement in gold output at Kinross but still nowhere near where we want it," he said.

"We are persevering in trying to get to that one tonne per month. We are not going to persevere for ever. If we don't get Kinross back to that level of production, we are going to permanently downscale it," Dale added.
The mine produced 2,321 kg of gold in the Sept quarter, 1.5 percent up on the 2,279 kg produced in the previous quarter.
Tonnes milled increased to 403,000 from the 382,000 tonnes milled in the second quarter but the average yield dropped to 5.8 grammes/tonne milled from the 6.0 g/t in the June quarter.
Kinross' distributable income dropped to 10.94 million rand in the September quarter from 21.97 million rand in the previous quarter.
